title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 4:17-5:2
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 4:17-5:2</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="17" /> From then on, Iesous began to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">announce</char> and say, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “Change-direction! 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        Because <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">the kingdom of</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="cyan">the skies</char> has come near!” 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="18" /> Now, while walking <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">beside the sea</char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="orange">Galilaia</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          he saw <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="green">two brothers</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">Simon</char>, <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">who is called</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">Petros</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">and</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">Andreas</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">his brother</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          throwing a fishing <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">net</char> into the sea, 
        </group>
        <group>
          because they were fishers, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="19" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">and he said to them</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “Come after me, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          and I will make you fishers of humans.” 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="20" /> And <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="orange">immediately, leaving</char> the <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">nets</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">they followed him</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="21" /> And having moved on from there, 
        </group>
        <group>
          he saw <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="green">two other brothers</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">Iakobos</char>, <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">the one of Zebedaios</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">and</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">Ioannes</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">his brother</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          in the boat with Zebedaios their father, 
        </group>
        <group>
          they were repairing their <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">nets</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">and he called to them</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="22" /> and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="orange">immediately, after leaving</char> the boat and their father, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">they followed him</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="23" /> And he traveled around in all of <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="orange">Galilaia</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="violet">teaching</char> in their synagogues, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">announcing the good news of the Kingdom</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">healing</char> every <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">sickness</char> <verse number="1" /> and every <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">disease</char> <verse number="2" /> among <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="violet">the people</char>.
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="24" /> And the report about him went out into all of Syria, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and they brought to him 
      </group>
      <group>
        all who had <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">illness with any variety of sicknesses</char>,<verse number="3" /> 
      </group>
      <group>
        and those suffering <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">tormenting-pain</char>,<verse number="4" /> 
      </group>
      <group>
        and the <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">demonized</char>,<verse number="5" /> 
      </group>
      <group>
        and those suffering <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">lunacy</char>,<verse number="6" /> 
      </group>
      <group>
        and the <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">paralyzed</char>,<verse number="7" /> 
      </group>
      <group>
        and he <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">healed</char> them.
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="25" /> And <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="violet">many crowds</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">followed him</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        from <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="orange">Galilaia</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and the Dekapolis, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Ierosoluma, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Ioudaia, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="orange">and beyond the Iordanes</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="5:1" /> and, seeing <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="violet">the crowds</char>, he went up onto <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="tan">the mountain</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and sitting down, his disciples came to him, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="2" /> and opening his mouth, <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="violet">he taught them</char>, saying, 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
